releaseNotes: Dev-dependency maintenance only; no skill behaviour, definition, or contract changes. The dev-dependencies group moves in lockstep across both manifests: @types/node 26.1.2, @types/react 19.2.18, @types/react-dom 19.2.4, @vitejs/plugin-react 6.0.5, motion 12.43.0, and vite 8.2.0. Dependabot splits this group into one PR per manifest root, and either half alone trips check:package-parity, so the two are landed as a single change.

Cursor joins Claude and Agents as a verified consumer of the installed runtime. scripts/sync-skill-runtime.sh now carries ~/.cursor/skills/b2c-mobile-business-launch in CONSUMER_LINKS, so one sync creates, repoints, and proves that link on the same terms as the others, and a real directory there fails the run instead of silently serving stale content. Cursor's vendor-owned ~/.cursor/skills-cursor is never synced into.
